text: The visible task `files` arrays mix workspace-absolute entries with repo-relative duplicates in tasks such as `OG-HOOK-001`, `OG-HOOK-002`, `OG-REPLAY-001`, `OG-DAEMON-001`, `OG-DRIFT-001`, `OG-DOC-002`, and `OG-SPEC-010`. Downstream capsule scope should therefore normalize these references to repo-relative paths.
